    <channel>
        <title>Travel Notices - CDC Travelers' Health </title>
        <description>Travel notices are designed to inform travelers and clinicians about current health issues related to specific destinations. These issues may arise from disease outbreaks, special events or gatherings, natural disasters, or other conditions that may affect travelers’ health.</description>
        <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices</link>

                        <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Chikungunya in Nicaragua</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Nicaragua. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/chikungunya-nicaragua</link>
                    <pubDate>Thu, 03 Sep 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/chikungunya-nicaragua</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 1 - Global Dengue</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[Dengue is a year-round risk in many parts of the world, with outbreaks commonly occurring every 2–5 years. Travelers to risk areas should prevent mosquito bites.  Country List :  Colombia, Vietnam, Maldives, Bolivia, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Costa Rica, Marshall Islands, Vanuatu]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/dengue-global</link>
                    <pubDate>Wed, 02 Sep 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/dengue-global</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 1 - Paratyphoid Fever in Yemen</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[Cases of paratyphoid fever are being reported in returning travelers from Yemen. You can prevent paratyphoid fever by practicing safe eating and drinking habits.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/paratyphoid-fever-yemen</link>
                    <pubDate>Wed, 26 Aug 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/paratyphoid-fever-yemen</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 1 - Diphtheria in Sub-Saharan Africa</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[There are outbreaks of diphtheria in several countries in Africa. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease.  Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia, Senegal Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia, Senegal Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia, Senega Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia, Senegal]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/diphtheria-sub-saharan-africa</link>
                    <pubDate>Tue, 25 Aug 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/diphtheria-sub-saharan-africa</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Zika in Indonesia</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[Cases of Zika are being reported in returning travelers from Bali, Indonesia. All travelers to Bali should take steps to prevent mosquito bites and sexual transmission of Zika virus during and after travel.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/zika-indonesia</link>
                    <pubDate>Fri, 07 Aug 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/zika-indonesia</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 4 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Ituri and Nord-Kivu Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[CDC recommends avoiding all travel to Ituri and Nord-Kivu (North-Kivu) provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak unless traveling for humanitarian aid or emergency response.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level4/ebola-drc-provinces</link>
                    <pubDate>Tue, 04 Aug 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level4/ebola-drc-provinces</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 3 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Haut-Uélé and Tshopo Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[CDC recommends avoiding nonessential travel to Haut-Uélé and Tshopo provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level3/ebola-democratic-republic-of-the-congo</link>
                    <pubDate>Tue, 04 Aug 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level3/ebola-democratic-republic-of-the-congo</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[CDC recommends practicing enhanced precautions for travel to Uganda or to provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) not affected by the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak. Country List :  Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda Country List :  Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda Country List :  Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda Country List :  Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda Country List :  Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/ebola-drc-uganda</link>
                    <pubDate>Tue, 04 Aug 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/ebola-drc-uganda</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Chikungunya in Costa Rica</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[There is an outbreak of chikungunya in northwest Costa Rica. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/chikungunya-costa-rica</link>
                    <pubDate>Thu, 30 Jul 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/chikungunya-costa-rica</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 1 - Diphtheria in Haiti</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[There is an outbreak of diphtheria in Haiti. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease. ]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/diphtheria-haiti</link>
                    <pubDate>Thu, 25 Jun 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/diphtheria-haiti</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Malaria in Yemen</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Yemen, including in areas that were previously considered low-risk.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/malaria-yemen</link>
                    <pubDate>Thu, 11 Jun 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/malaria-yemen</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Chikungunya in French Guiana</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[There is an outbreak of chikungunya in French Guiana. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/chikungunya-french-guiana</link>

                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 1 - Hepatitis A in Canada</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[Manitoba, Canada is currently experiencing a hepatitis A virus (HAV) outbreak. HAV is contagious and spreads through close person-to-person contact and by eating contaminated food or drink.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/hepatitis-a-canada</link>
                    <pubDate>Thu, 04 Jun 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/hepatitis-a-canada</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Malaria in Mayotte</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Mayotte. Malaria is spread by the bite of infected mosquitoes. ]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/malaria-mayotte</link>
                    <pubDate>Tue, 02 Jun 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/malaria-mayotte</guid>
                </item>

                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Meningococcal Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[There is an outbreak of meningococcal disease in the Mangembo Health Zone of Kongo Central Province. The best way to protect yourself is to get meningococcal vaccination.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/meningococcal-drc</link>
                    <pubDate>Tue, 24 Mar 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/meningococcal-drc</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Venezuela</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[An increased number of cases of yellow fever have been reported throughout Venezuela. ]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/yellow-fever-venezuela</link>
                    <pubDate>Mon, 16 Mar 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/yellow-fever-venezuela</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Global Polio</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[Some international destinations have circulating poliovirus. Before any international travel, make sure you are up to date on your polio vaccines.          Country List :  Afghanistan, Algeria, Benin, Cameroon, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast), Democratic Republic of the Congo, Niger, Nigeria, Pakistan, Somalia, Yemen, Sudan, Guinea, Angola, Senegal, Ethiopia, Republic of South Sudan, Djibouti, Israel, the West Bank and Gaza, Germany, Poland, United Kingdom, including England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, Burkina Faso, Papua New Guinea, Central African Republic, Tanzania, including Zanzibar, Laos, Namibia]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/global-polio</link>
                    <pubDate>Mon, 09 Mar 2026 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/global-polio</guid>
                </item>

                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/chikungunya-bolivia</link>

                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/chikungunya-bolivia</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 1 - Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever in Mexico </title>
                    <description><![CDATA[Illness and death due to Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF) have been reported in the northern region of Mexico along the U.S. border, particularly in Baja California, Sonora, Chihuahua, Coahuila, and Nuevo León.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/rmsf-mexico</link>
                    <pubDate>Tue, 23 Dec 2025 05:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level1/rmsf-mexico</guid>
                </item> 
                <item>
                    <title>Level 2 - Yellow Fever in Colombia</title>
                    <description><![CDATA[An increased number of cases of yellow fever have been reported in Colombia.]]></description>
                    <link>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/yellow-fever-colombia</link>
                    <pubDate>Tue, 02 Sep 2025 04:00:00 GMT</pubDate>
                    <guid>https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices/level2/yellow-fever-colombia</guid>
                </item>
